title: LinkedIn Company Post Monitor
description: Add URLs directly, paste CSV, or upload a CSV file. $1 per 1,000 URLs.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: A url column. One URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 50,000. A list over 200 continues if the run stops.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many URLs to look up at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip URLs that already succeeded.

freshStart.title: Start the watch again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress. A post monitor also forgets saved post IDs and takes a new baseline.

watchId.title: Watch list ID
watchId.description: Stable ID for this company list. Reuse it on every scheduled run.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named store that remembers which posts were already seen.

webhookUrl.title: New post webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives new posts only. The baseline run does not call it.
